name: dawnmere-connector
description: One memory shared across your AI apps. Connects to Dawnmere on your Mac.
long_description: Dawnmere gives Claude, Cursor, Codex and your other AI apps one shared memory, kept on your Mac. This extension connects Claude Desktop to Dawnmere: it searches, saves and forgets memories through Dawnmere and stores nothing itself. Early beta: it needs Dawnmere running on the same Mac.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search the user's memory by meaning and keywords.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save one durable fact for future conversations.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Retire a memory that is wrong or that the user asked to forget.

tools.name: access_status
tools.description: Say what this app can see in the user's memory.
